===Cargo===
With the exception of Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, all remaining international flights moved to  [[Chengdu Tianfu International Airport|new airport]], with Shuangliu serving scheduled domestic and international cargo flights.

As of 2025, it operates cargo flights to East Asia, Southeast Asia, Europe, West Asia, North America and South Asia.
